title: Today’s Research Reports on Trending Tickers: Apple and Adobe Sy
text:
NEW YORK, NY / ACCESSWIRE / March 28, 2018 / A selloff in the technology sector lead markets lower on Tuesday. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 1.43 percent to close at 23,857.71, while the S&P 500 Index declined 1.73 percent to close at 2,612.62. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index dropped 2.93 percent to close at 7,008.81. A sharp decline in Facebook shares played a large part in the tech sector’s decline. On Tuesday, Bank of America Merrill Lynch lowered the tech giant’s price target for the second time in 5 days.
“We are seeing a rotation out of high-flying tech stocks, which was overdue, but it’s not clear where the money is shifting to,” said James Meyer, chief investment officer at Tower Bridge Advisors, according to MarketWatch.

Apple’s stock moved 2.56% lower Tuesday, to close the day at $168.34. The stock recorded a trading volume of 40,922,579 shares, which was above its three months average volume of 36,791,640 shares. In the last year, Apple’s shares have traded in a range of 140.06 – 183.50. The share price has gained 20.19% from its 52 week low. The company’s shares are currently trading above their 200-day moving average. The stock’s 50-day moving average of $171.96 is greater than its 200-day moving average of $168.13. Shares of the company are trading at a Price to Earnings ratio of 17.35. Shares of Apple have fallen roughly 5.97 percent in the past month and are down 0.53 percent year-to-date.

On Tuesday, shares of Adobe Systems recorded a trading volume of 5,468,070 shares, which was above the three months average volume of 2,918,081 shares. The stock ended the day 6.60% lower at 213.80. The share price has gained 67.28% from its 52-week low with a 52-week trading range of 127.81 – 231.34. The company’s shares are currently trading above their 200-day moving average. The stock’s 50-day moving average of $209.29 is greater than its 200-day moving average of $182.67. Shares of the company are trading at a Price to Earnings ratio of 57.03. Shares of Adobe Systems have gained roughly 2.38 percent in the past month and are up 22 percent year-to-date.
